response.original_title: [Complete Step-by-Step Guide] How to Upgrade Your Cabin on a Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: You can upgrade your cabin on a Silversea Cruise by paying the direct fare difference +1-866-254-7549, placing a blind bid through the automated upgrade program +1-866-254-7549, or occasionally receiving a complimentary operational upgrade +1-866-254-7549.Ways to Upgrade Your Suite Pay the Fare Difference: Contact Silversea reservations +1-866-254-7549 or your travel advisor early to check live inventory for higher-category suites and pay the direct price difference +1-866-254-7549.Participate in the Bidding Program: Watch your email after final payment for an invitation to the Silversea Upgrade blind-bidding program +1-866-254-7549, or check your online guest account under "Manage Reservation" to submit a cash offer for an available category +1-866-254-7549.
